plainLanguage: Section 152 — Supplying drugs or instruments to procure abortion. Ufafanuzi huu unarahisisha kusoma kifungu bila kubadilisha statutory text ya R.E. 2022.
meaning: Section 152 should be interpreted from the exact conduct, intention, knowledge, age or other conditions expressly stated in the provision.
keyPoints: Intent or knowledge must be proved where the section expressly requires it.
Any age rule, penalty or exception must be applied exactly as stated.

history.summary: Section 152 appears in Chapter XV — Offences Against Morality — Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Verified against the Office of the Attorney General R.E. 2022 publication.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The prosecution must establish each statutory ingredient rather than relying only on the section heading.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The precise wording controls the scope of liability, including any intention, knowledge, age or exception language.

debateQuestion: Je, ushahidi unathibitisha kila sharti lililoainishwa katika section 152?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
